judge.label: LLM rubric score, fresh-context judge, self-assessed — not human QA.
judge.independence_caveat: This judge is a different model family and a fresh context: it saw only the judge prompt, the rubric and the lesson. It did not direct the project and did not author anything in it. It is still a language model scoring a language model's output, so the label applies: not human QA.

notes.level_fidelity: L2 heading declares level 2 but is visually identical to L1 heading; no visible progression in block type or depth.
notes.knowledge_check: Feedback on distractors is strong but slightly repetitive in phrasing; could name misconceptions more distinctly.
notes.concision: Some Arabic and English prose is clear but slightly wordy; minor trimming possible without loss.

verdict_notes: Strong alignment and worked example; minor improvements possible in level fidelity, knowledge check feedback, and concision. All criteria at or above 4.
